model: ServingStackEvaluator from operational repository, current config, single fit on verified 1520 training matches; all model and Elo state frozen thereafter

calibration.method: Brier-optimal scalar convex blend per market: q + w*(p-q), q proportional devig of same retrospective market quotes; w=clip(sum((onehot(y)-q)*(p-q))/sum((p-q)^2),0,1)
calibration.sample: all valid 2025 complete price vectors, identical quote gates to 2026; never fit on 2026

arms.primary_calibrated: 2021-2024 serving model plus frozen 2025 scalar market blend
arms.diagnostic_raw: same frozen model without 2025 blend; descriptive comparator, never promoted based on 2026 results

selection.rank: maximum p*odd-1-0.02, then market order, then side order
selection.price_source: existing retrospective flat aggregate columns in verified historical input (2025) and sofascore_matches (2026); no attested historical bookmaker or quote timestamp

accounting.illustration: constant R$50 per wager, purely linear conversion of units; disclose any capital insufficiency
accounting.drawdown: chronological cumulative net profit by kickoff and event id, with initial zero
accounting.uncompleted_or_unavailable_outcome: excluded from settlement and ROI, retained in full official fixture denominator

interpretation: Retrospective exploratory replay; 2026 has previously been explored. Plan frozen before this run's new result extraction, not a historical preregistration. Only completed available matches through cutoff can have realized counterfactual payouts. No evidence of future full-turn profit or quote executability.
stop: Execute both predefined arms once, audit arithmetic and leakage, report result including zero/negative; no tuning on either 2026 turn; no live wagers or operational cohort evaluation
